about: Gaia DR3 stars that move more than 0.5 arcsec a year. A row is [source_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, parallax, g]: position in degrees (ICRS) at `epoch`; proper motion in mas a year, pmra being the motion in right ascension times cos(dec); parallax in mas; G magnitude (null when Gaia gives none). Sorted by ra.
source: Gaia DR3, table gaia_source, as served by the Mikulski Archive for Space Telescopes (MAST)
checked: A second copy of the catalogue (table gaia.dr3lite of the GAVO Data Center) gives the same 4746 sources above the speed; positions agree within 1e-07 degree, proper motions and parallaxes within 0.002 mas a year and mas.
